name: Gamma-endorphin
summary: γ-Endorphin (gamma-endorphin) is an opioid peptide that is characterized by the presence of 17 amino acids. The first 16 amino acids are identical to α-endorphin; leucine added at the end. In addition, γ-endorphin is identical to the first 17 amino acids of β-endorphin. Similar to other endorphins, research focusing upon γ-endorphin has been ongoing since its discovery in the 1970s.

uses.text: Some studies have indicated, however, that the polypeptide has antipsychotic effects on a certain category of patients with schizophrenia, while others suggest that γ-endorphin may act to help regulate blood pressure. Further research is needed, but if γ-endorphin does indeed possess such characteristics, the substance could eventually be utilized as a useful means of medical treatment.

pharmacology.en: It is cut from a larger precursor protein, pro-opiomelanocortin, which also gives rise to beta-endorphin. It can bind opioid receptors, but some of its effects studied in animals appear not to depend on them.
pharmacology.zh: 它由較大的前驅蛋白「前腦啡黑素皮質素」切割而成，β-腦內啡也來自同一前驅物。它能與類鴉片受體結合，但動物研究中觀察到的部分作用似乎與這些受體無關。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它由较大的前驱蛋白「前脑啡黑素皮质素」切割而成，β-脑内啡也来自同一前驱物。它能与类鸦片受体结合，但动物研究中观察到的部分作用似乎与这些受体无关。

fact.en: The word endorphin is short for endogenous morphine, meaning a morphine-like substance the body makes itself. Gamma-endorphin is one of several such peptides found in the 1970s.
fact.zh: 「腦內啡」一詞是「內源性嗎啡」的縮寫，意思是身體自行製造的類嗎啡物質。γ-腦內啡是 1970 年代發現的幾種這類胜肽之一。
fact.zhHans: 「脑内啡」一词是「内源性吗啡」的缩写，意思是身体自行制造的类吗啡物质。γ-脑内啡是 1970 年代发现的几种这类胜肽之一。
